outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery vs. cesarean delivery)
cohort: 796 women who underwent labor induction at a tertiary center university teaching hospital over a one-year period
finding: Fetal indications for induction (including intra-uterine growth restriction, oligohydramnios, placental abruption, macrosomia, and post-term pregnancy) were found to significantly increase the risk of cesarean delivery in nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Fetal indications for induction significantly increase the risk of cesarean delivery in nulliparous women.
